This document describes how to get and manipulate data from [unified checklist](https://www.gbif.org/dataset/6d9e952f-948c-4483-9807-575348147c7e) for checklist-based indicators.

# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

Load libraries:

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse) # To do data science
library(tidylog) # To provide feedback on dplyr functions
library(janitor) # To clean column names
library(here) # To find files
library(rgbif) # To get taxa from publisehd unified checklist
library(rcol) # To get new functionality from gbif
library(trias) # To get indicator functionalities
```

# Get data

## Get taxonomic data

Get taxa from the published unified checklist, the [*Global Register of Introduced and Invasive Species - Belgium*](https://www.gbif.org/dataset/6d9e952f-948c-4483-9807-575348147c7e):

```{r}
GRIIS_checklist_folder <- "./data/input/GRIIS_checklist/"

download.file(url = "https://ipt.inbo.be/archive.do?r=unified-checklist",
              destfile = "./data/input/GRIIS_checklist.zip",
              mode = "wb")

dir.create(GRIIS_checklist_folder, recursive = TRUE)

unzip(zipfile = "./data/input/GRIIS_checklist.zip",
      exdir = GRIIS_checklist_folder,
      overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r get_data_unified_checklist}
taxa_keys <- name_usage(
  datasetKey = "6d9e952f-948c-4483-9807-575348147c7e",
  limit = 10000
)
taxa_keys <- 
  taxa_keys$data %>% 
  filter(origin == "SOURCE") |> 
  select(nubKey, key) |> 
  group_by(nubKey) |> 
  summarise(key = first(key)) |> 
  ungroup()

taxa_raw <- read_tsv(paste0(GRIIS_checklist_folder, "taxon.txt"))

taxa <- taxa_raw |>
  mutate(nubKey = as.integer(gsub(pattern = "https://www.gbif.org/species/",
                                  replacement = "",
                                  id)),
         canonicalName_raw = paste(genus, specificEpithet)) |> 
  rename(datasetKey = datasetID,
         rank = taxonRank) |> 
  left_join(taxa_keys, by = "nubKey")

scientificNames <- taxa$nubKey |>
  map_dfr(function(tk) {
    # Direct lookup is practically instant
    info <- name_usage(key = tk)$data
    
    # Safely check if the column exists and return a dataframe for map_dfr
    if (!is.null(info) && "canonicalName" %in% names(info)) {
      
      return(data.frame(
        nubKey = tk, 
        species = if ("species" %in% names(info)) info$species else NA_character_,
        canonicalName_gbif = if ("canonicalName" %in% names(info)) info$canonicalName else NA_character_,
        kingdomKey = if ("kingdomKey" %in% names(info)) info$kingdomKey else NA_integer_,
        phylumKey = if ("phylumKey" %in% names(info)) info$phylumKey else NA_integer_,
        classKey = if ("classKey" %in% names(info)) info$classKey else NA_integer_,
        orderKey = if ("orderKey" %in% names(info)) info$orderKey else NA_integer_,
        familyKey = if ("familyKey" %in% names(info)) info$familyKey else NA_integer_,
        genusKey = if ("genusKey" %in% names(info)) info$genusKey else NA_integer_,
        speciesKey = if ("speciesKey" %in% names(info)) info$speciesKey else NA_integer_,
        taxonomicStatus = if ("taxonomicStatus" %in% names(info)) info$taxonomicStatus else NA_character_
      ))
    }
    
    # Return empty dataframe if missing to prevent map_dfr from crashing
    return(data.frame(nubKey = tk, 
                      canonicalName_gbif = NA_character_,
                      species = NA_character_,
                      kingdomKey = NA_integer_,
                      phylumKey = NA_integer_,
                      classKey = NA_integer_,
                      orderKey = NA_integer_,
                      familyKey = NA_integer_,
                      genusKey = NA_integer_,
                      speciesKey = NA_integer_,
                      taxonomicStatus = NA_character_)) 
    
  }, .progress = "Fetching names")

taxa <- taxa |> 
  left_join(scientificNames, by = "nubKey") |> 
  mutate(canonicalName = coalesce(canonicalName_gbif, canonicalName_raw),
         speciesKey = coalesce(speciesKey, nubKey),
         acceptedKey = nubKey,
         accepted = ifelse(taxonomicStatus == "ACCEPTED", TRUE, FALSE))
```

Select columns we are interested to:

```{r select_cols_interest}
checklist_info <- c(
  "key", "nubKey", "scientificName", "datasetKey",
  "canonicalName", "species", "genus", "family",
  "order", "class", "phylum", "kingdom",
  "rank", "speciesKey", "genusKey", "familyKey",
  "orderKey", "classKey", "phylumKey", "kingdomKey", 
  "taxonomicStatus", "acceptedKey", "accepted"
)
taxa <-
  taxa %>%
  select(one_of(checklist_info))
```

## Get distribution

Extract distribution information

```{r retrieve_distribution_information, cache=TRUE}
distribution <- read_tsv(paste0(GRIIS_checklist_folder, "distribution.txt"))
distribution <- distribution %>% 
  select(-source) |> 
  mutate(taxonKey = as.integer(gsub(pattern = "https://www.gbif.org/species/",
                                    replacement = "",
                                    id)))
head(distribution)
```

## Get description

Extract description information

```{r retrieve_description_information, cache=TRUE}
description <- read_tsv(paste0(GRIIS_checklist_folder, "description.txt"))
description <- description %>% 
  mutate(taxonKey = as.integer(gsub(pattern = "https://www.gbif.org/species/",
                                    replacement = "",
                                    id))) |> 
  select(-c(id, language, source))
head(description, n = 10)
```

Description contains a column `type` with the following descriptors: 

```{r descriptors}
description %>% distinct(type)
```
**Patch**: pathways `"introduction pathway"` and `"pathway of introduction"` should be renamed to  `pathways`. Bug documented in issue [#68](https://github.com/trias-project/unified-checklist/issues/68).

We are interested to the following types:

```{r define_types}
types <- c(
  "native range"
)
```

We filter out the other types:

```{r select_types}
description <-
  description %>%
  filter(type %in% types)
```

We *tidy* this data.frame, thus having different descriptors as different columns:

```{r tidy_description}
description <-
  description %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = type,
    values_from = description,
    values_fn = list(name = list)
  ) %>%
  unnest_longer(types[1])
description %>% head(n = 20)
```

We also clean column names by standardizing column names (snake_case):

```{r standardize_colnames}
description <-
  description %>%
  janitor::clean_names(case = "snake") %>%
  rename(taxonKey = taxon_key)
names(description)
```

### Mapping `degree of establishment`

Values in column `degree_of_establishment`:

```{r degree_of_establishment}
distribution %>%
  distinct(degreeOfEstablishment)
```

We map them as follows:

```{r mapping_degree_of_establishment}
distribution <-
  distribution %>%
  mutate(degree_of_establishment = case_match(
    degreeOfEstablishment,
    c("casual", 
      "NA|casual", 
      "casual|NA") ~ "casual",
    "reproducing (blackburn_2011:C2)" ~ "reproducing",
    c("established", 
      "casual|established", 
      "established|casual",
      "established|casual|NA",
      "established|NA",
      "NA|established") ~ "established",
    "colonising " ~ "colonizing",
    c("casual|invasive",
      "established|invasive",
      "invasive") ~ "invasive",
    "blackburn_et_al_2011:E" ~ "widespreadInvasive",
    .default = degreeOfEstablishment
  ))

table(distribution$degreeOfEstablishment, distribution$degree_of_establishment)
table(distribution$degree_of_establishment)
```

Mapping result:

```{r mapping_degree_establ_result}
distribution %>%
  distinct(degree_of_establishment)
```

### Add native continent based on native range

We use native range information to create a similar column containing native continent:

```{r add_native_continent_column}
description <-
  description %>%
  mutate(native_continent = case_when(
    grepl(pattern = "Africa", native_range, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Africa",
    grepl(pattern = "America", native_range, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "America",
    grepl(pattern = "Asia", native_range, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Asia",
    grepl(pattern = "Australia", native_range, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Oceania",
    grepl(pattern = "nesia", native_range, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Oceania",
    grepl(pattern = "Europe", native_range, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Europe",
    TRUE ~ as.character(NA))
  )
```

Mapping result:

```{r mapping_native_continent_result}
description %>%
  distinct(native_continent)
```


### Mapping `pathway`

This section contains a series of patches to standardize pathway information.

Add prefix `cbd_2014_pathway:` where missing (see [issue #69](https://github.com/trias-project/unified-checklist/issues/69)):

pathway_lvl1: contaminant  corridor  escape     release    stowaway     unaided     unknown
pathway_lvl2:agriculture  animal_parasite  aquaculture         ballast_water    biological_control          conservation     container                  farm               fishery                  food             food_bait              fur_farm habitat_material          horticulture          hull_fouling               hunting landscape_improvement     natural_dispersal nursery            on_animals             on_plants       organic_packing                 other        people_luggage pet              research                  seed                  ship                timber               unknown vehicles                 water                   zoo 

```{r add_cbd_2014_pathway_if_missing} 
distribution <- distribution %>%
  mutate(pathway = trimws(pathway)) %>%
  # Level 1 Mapping
  mutate(pathway_lvl1 = case_when(
    # UNAIDED
    str_detect(pathway, "naturalDispersal") ~ "unaided",
    
    # CORRIDOR
    str_detect(pathway, "waterwaysBasinsSeas|corridor_water") ~ "corridor",
    
    # RELEASE (Intentional release into the wild)
    str_detect(pathway, "biologicalControl|conservationOrWildlifeManagement|fisheryInTheWild|hunting|landscapeImprovement|otherIntentionalRelease") ~ "release",
    
    # ESCAPE (From confinement)
    str_detect(pathway, "agriculture|aquacultureMariculture|farmedAnimals|horticulture|liveFoodLiveBait|pet|publicGardenZooAquaria|research") ~ "escape",
    
    # CONTAMINANT (Contaminant of plants/animals/products)
    str_detect(pathway, "contaminant|parasitesOnAnimals|seedContaminant|timberTrade|transportationHabitatMaterial") ~ "contaminant",
    
    # STOWAWAY (On transport/vessels/containers)
    str_detect(pathway, "ballastWater|containerBulk|hitchhikersShip|hullFouling|otherTransport|people|vehicles|stowaway|transportStowaway") ~ "stowaway",
    
    # UNKNOWN / NA
    is.na(pathway) | pathway == "NA" ~ "unknown",
    TRUE ~ "unknown"
  )) %>%
  
  # Level 2 Mapping
  mutate(pathway_lvl2 = case_when(
    # --- UNAIDED ---
    str_detect(pathway, "naturalDispersal") ~ "natural_dispersal",
    
    # --- CORRIDOR ---
    str_detect(pathway, "waterwaysBasinsSeas|corridor_water") ~ "water",
    
    # --- RELEASE ---
    str_detect(pathway, "biologicalControl") ~ "biological_control",
    str_detect(pathway, "conservationOrWildlifeManagement") ~ "conservation",
    str_detect(pathway, "fisheryInTheWild") ~ "fishery",
    str_detect(pathway, "hunting") ~ "hunting",
    str_detect(pathway, "landscapeImprovement") ~ "landscape_improvement",
    str_detect(pathway, "otherIntentionalRelease") ~ "other",
    
    # --- ESCAPE ---
    str_detect(pathway, "agriculture") ~ "agriculture",
    str_detect(pathway, "aquacultureMariculture") ~ "aquaculture",
    str_detect(pathway, "farmedAnimals") ~ "farm",
    str_detect(pathway, "horticulture") ~ "horticulture",
    str_detect(pathway, "liveFoodLiveBait") ~ "food_bait",
    str_detect(pathway, "pet") ~ "pet",
    str_detect(pathway, "publicGardenZooAquaria") ~ "zoo",
    str_detect(pathway, "research") ~ "research",
    
    # --- CONTAMINANT ---
    str_detect(pathway, "contaminantNursery") ~ "nursery",
    str_detect(pathway, "contaminantOnAnimals") ~ "on_animals",
    str_detect(pathway, "parasitesOnAnimals") ~ "animal_parasite",
    str_detect(pathway, "contaminantOnPlants") ~ "on_plants",
    str_detect(pathway, "seedContaminant") ~ "seed",
    str_detect(pathway, "timberTrade") ~ "timber",
    str_detect(pathway, "transportationHabitatMaterial") ~ "habitat_material",
    
    # --- STOWAWAY ---
    str_detect(pathway, "ballastWater") ~ "ballast_water",
    str_detect(pathway, "hullFouling") ~ "hull_fouling",
    str_detect(pathway, "containerBulk") ~ "container",
    str_detect(pathway, "hitchhikersShip|stowaway_ship") ~ "ship",
    str_detect(pathway, "people") ~ "people_luggage",
    str_detect(pathway, "vehicles") ~ "vehicles",
    str_detect(pathway, "otherTransport|transportStowaway|stowaway") ~ "other",
    
    # --- UNKNOWN / CATCH-ALL ---
    is.na(pathway) | pathway == "NA" ~ "unknown",
    TRUE ~ "unknown"
  ))

missing_pathway_lvl1 <- distribution |> 
  filter(is.na(distribution$pathway_lvl1))

table(missing_pathway_lvl1$pathway)

missing_pathway_lvl2 <- distribution |> 
  filter(is.na(distribution$pathway_lvl2))

table(missing_pathway_lvl2$pathway)
```
Pathway `cbd_2014_pathway:agriculture` should be replaced by `cbd_2014_pathway:escape_agriculture` (see [issue #38](https://github.com/trias-project/ad-hoc-checklist/issues/38)):

```{r improve_pathway_agriculture}
distribution <- 
  distribution %>%
  mutate(pathway = if_else(pathway == "cbd_2014_pathway:agriculture",
                           "cbd_2014_pathway:escape_agriculture",
                           pathway)
  )
```
Pathway `contaminant_plant` should be replaced by `contaminant_on_plants` (see [issue #9](https://github.com/trias-project/alien-scheldt-checklist/issues/9)) 

```{r improve_pathway_on_plant}
distribution <- 
  distribution %>%
  mutate(pathway = if_else(pathway == "cbd_2014_pathway:contaminant_plant",
                           "cbd_2014_pathway:contaminant_on_plants",
                           pathway)
  )
```

Remove pathway `unintentional` as it is not a valid pathway (see [issue #3](https://github.com/trias-project/alien-fishes-checklist/issues/3)):

```{r remove_unintentional}
distribution <- 
  distribution  %>%
  filter(!pathway %in% c("cbd_2014_pathway:unintentional"))
```

Rename pathway `nursery` as `contaminant_nursery` (see [issue #40](https://github.com/trias-project/ad-hoc-checklist/issues/40)):

```{r rename_nursery}
distribution <- 
  distribution  %>%
  mutate(pathway = if_else(pathway == "cbd_2014_pathway:nursery",
                           "cbd_2014_pathway:contaminant_nursery",
                           pathway)
  )
```

## Species profile

Extract species profile

```{r retrieve_species_profile_information, cache=TRUE}
speciesProfiles <- taxa %>%
  filter(!is.na(key)) |> 
  pull(key) |> 
  map_dfr(function(x) {
    species_profiles_details <- name_usage(x, data = "speciesProfile")
    return(species_profiles_details$data)
  }
  ) 
head(speciesProfiles)
```

# Merge data

Merge distribution, description and species profile information:

```{r merge_extensions_information}
merged_extensions <-
  full_join(distribution,
            description,
            by = "taxonKey"
  ) 
```

to merge them all with the taxonomic information:

```{r merge_extensions_with_taxa}
merged_info <- left_join(taxa, merged_extensions,
                         by = c("nubKey" = "taxonKey")) %>%
  left_join(speciesProfiles,
            by = c("key" = "taxonKey")
  )
merged_info %>% head(n = 100)
```

# Tidy data

Some columns should be splitted in order to make the data.frame completely tidy: `temporal` and `pathway`.

## Split column `temporal`

The column `temporal` contains one or two datums:

```{r example_temporal, echo = FALSE}
merged_info %>%
  select(key, eventDate) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(eventDate)) %>%
  head()
```

In case there are two datums, we split them in `first_observed` and `last_observed`. If only a datum is present, then it is used for both  `first_observed`and `last_observed`.

```{r split_temporal}
merged_info <-
  merged_info %>%
  separate(
    col = eventDate,
    sep = "/",
    into = c("first_observed", "last_observed"),
    convert = TRUE,
    fill = "right",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(last_observed = ifelse(is.na(last_observed),
                                first_observed,
                                last_observed
  ))
```

An example:

```{r example_split_temporal, echo = FALSE}
merged_info %>%
  filter(locality == "Belgium") %>%
  select(key, first_observed, last_observed) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(first_observed) & !is.na(last_observed)) %>%
  head(10)
```

Some `first_observed` are greater than `last_observed`, (see [issue #41](https://github.com/trias-project/ad-hoc-checklist/issues/41)):

```{r exceptions_temporal}
wrong_temporal <- 
  merged_info %>%
  filter(last_observed < first_observed)
wrong_temporal %>%
  distinct(key, first_observed, last_observed)
```

Correct them:

```{r correct_temporal_info}
# invert first/last_observed columns 
wrong_temporal$aux <- wrong_temporal$first_observed
wrong_temporal$first_observed <- wrong_temporal$last_observed
wrong_temporal$last_observed <- wrong_temporal$aux
wrong_temporal$aux <- NULL
wrong_temporal %>%
  distinct(key, first_observed, last_observed)
# replace wrong rows with the corrected ones
merged_info <- merged_info %>%
  anti_join(wrong_temporal, 
            by = c("key", "nubKey", "scientificName", "datasetKey",
                   "canonicalName", "species", "genus", "family", "order", 
                   "class", "phylum", "kingdom", "rank", "speciesKey", 
                   "taxonomicStatus", "locationID", "locality", "countryCode", 
                   "occurrenceStatus", "establishmentMeans", "pathway", 
                   "degree_of_establishment", "native_range", 
                   "native_continent", "habitat", "marine", "freshwater",
                   "terrestrial", "source")) %>%
  bind_rows(wrong_temporal) %>%
  arrange(key)
```


## Split column `pathway`

The column `pathway` contains a prefix, `cbd_2014_pathway:` and two different pathway levels divided by symbol `_` (Note: this is not valid for pathway `natural_dispersal`, which should not be divided in two levels as it is a level 2 pathway of level 1 `unaided`):

```{r pathway_levels_example, echo = FALSE}
merged_info %>%
  distinct(pathway_lvl1, pathway_lvl2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pathway_lvl1)) %>%
  head(10)
```

We split `pathway` in `pathway_level1` and `pathway_level2` assigning value `unknown` if pathway is empty (`NA`) or a zero-length string (`""`). We also assign level 2 `natural_dispersal` to taxa with pathway level 1 `unaided`, as suggested by Tim Adriaens in [trias-project/indicators#61 (comment)](https://github.com/trias-project/indicators/issues/61#issuecomment-611704751):

Full mapping:
```{r read template}
griis_checklist_template <- read_tsv(
  file = here::here(
    "data",
    "output",
    "UAT_processing",
    "data_input_checklist_indicators.tsv"
  ),
  na = ""
) |> 
  select(-c(vernacular_name_en, 
            vernacular_name_fr, 
            vernacular_name_nl, 
            vernacular_name_en_list, 
            vernacular_name_fr_list, 
            vernacular_name_nl_list))

merged_info_mpd <- merged_info |> 
  rename(locationId = locationID,
         country = countryCode,
         status = occurrenceStatus,
         pathway_level1 = pathway_lvl1,
         pathway_level2 = pathway_lvl2) |> 
  select(all_of(names(griis_checklist_template)))

fistools::colcompare(griis_checklist_template, merged_info_mpd)

missing_in_x <- data.frame() |> 
  mutate(column = NA_character_,
         missing_data = NA_character_,
         failure_rate = NA_integer_)
missing_in_y <- data.frame() |> 
  mutate(column = NA_character_,
         missing_data = NA_character_,
         failure_rate = NA_integer_)

for(c in colnames(griis_checklist_template)){
  test <- fistools::col_content_compare(griis_checklist_template, c, 
                                        merged_info_mpd, c)
  
  n_distinct_x <- n_distinct(griis_checklist_template[[c]])
  n_distinct_y <- n_distinct(merged_info_mpd[[c]])
  
  test_missing_in_x <- test$missing_from_col1
  test_missing_in_y <- test$missing_from_col2
  
  if(!is_empty(test_missing_in_x)){
    missing_in_x <- missing_in_x |> 
      add_row(column = c,
              missing_data = as.character(test_missing_in_x),
              failure_rate = length(test_missing_in_x)/n_distinct_x)
  }
  if(!is_empty(test_missing_in_y)){
    missing_in_y <- missing_in_y |> 
      add_row(column = c,
              missing_data = as.character(test_missing_in_y),
              failure_rate = length(test_missing_in_y)/n_distinct_y)
  }
}
```


```{r example_split_pathway, echo = FALSE}
merged_info %>%
  distinct(pathway_lvl1, pathway_lvl2) %>%
  arrange(pathway_lvl1)
```
# Save data

The data.frame `merged_info` is saved as output file:

```{r save_data_output, eval=FALSE}
write_tsv(merged_info, 
          file = here::here(
            "data",
            "interim",
            "data_input_checklist_indicators.tsv"
          ),
          na = ""
)
```

This file is the start point for building checklist-based indicators.
